root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bare ve ettirgen alanlari birlikte temsil eder; kurtulusun sadece sonucunu degil ayrilma yoluyla gerceklesmesini de korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kurtulus, ayrilma ve uzaklasma iliskisini birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin ya da seyin zararli, baglayici veya istenmeyen bir durumdan ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmasi; ettirgen bicimlerde baska birini bu ayrilmaya ulastirip kurtarmadir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, kotu veya baglayici bir seyden ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmadir.
Ettirgen kullanim, baskasini ayni kurtulus sonucuna ulastirmayi bildirir.
Kurtulus sebebi adi, kisiyi tehlikeden ayiran arac ya da yol olarak baglidir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin kotu bir durumdan cikmasi anlatildiginda dogal Turkce karsiliktir; ayrilma yolu baglamdan anlasilir.

error_profile.loses: Ayrilip uzaklasma islemini acikca soylemeyebilir.
error_profile.preserves: Kurtulus sonucunu dogal bicimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Baska birini zararli durumdan cikaran ettirgen kullanimlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Baskasini kurtulus durumuna ulastirma iliskisini korur.

error_profile.adds: Cekirdekte olmayan hiz unsurunu ekler.
error_profile.collision: B002 dalinin hizli gitme anlamiyla karisir.
error_profile.loses: Tehlikeden ayrilarak kurtulma cekirdegini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Uzaklasma hareketiyle zayif bir temas kurabilir.

error_profile.adds: Konusma ve gizlilik alanini ekler.
error_profile.collision: B005 dalinin anlamiyla karisir.
error_profile.loses: Kurtulus ve ayrilma cekirdegini tamamen yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Ayni kok ailesindeki ayri bir alani korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kurtulusun ayrilma ve uzaklasma ile gerceklesmesine baglidir; yalniz hiz veya yalniz koruma degildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kisinin ya da seyin zararli veya istenmeyen bir durumdan ondan ayrilip uzaklasarak kurtulmasini ve baska birini bu durumdan kurtarmayi birlikte verir. Gecici dal cercevesi bu ayrilma yoluyla kurtulus cekirdegini dogru tasir; hiz, gizli konusma ve bedensel cikinti anlamlari bu dalin disinda kalir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karisik kapsam, yalpan kurtulma fiilini, baskasini kurtarma bicimlerini ve sebep adi kullanimini ayri ama ayni cekirdege bagli tutar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular kurtarma, siginak, koruma, hiz ve ayni kokun obur dallari acisindan denetlendi; yalniz siniri aciklastiran en yararli karsitliklar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yerine koyma ancak kurtarma olayinin kendisi anlatildiginda mumkundur. Bu dal ayrilma yoluyla kurtulma ve kurtulmus olma tarafini da tasirken, komsu dal daha belirgin olarak etkin kurtarma eylemini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kurtulanin bir seyden ayrilip uzaklasmasini da cekirdekte tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle birini zor durumdan veya baskasinin elinden cekip cikarma eylemine odaklanir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da zararli veya baglayici bir durumdan kurtulus ya da kurtarma vardir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dalda once bir yere takilma veya tutulma durumu daha belirgindir. Bu dal daha genis olarak serden, kisiden veya durumdan ayrilarak kurtulmayi karsilar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal genel olarak istenmeyen seyden ayrilip kurtulmayi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle bir seye takilmis veya tutulmus durumdan cikmayi vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da baglayici bir halden cikis ve kurtulus bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklasma kurtulusun yoludur; komsu dalda uzaklasma hiz ve acele hareket olarak tanimlanir. Bu yuzden biri digerinin yerine genel olarak kullanilmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalin sonucu kurtulustur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalin cekirdegi hizli gitme ve one gecmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bir yerden uzaklasma dusuncesi bulunabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak, bir seyin icinden veya etkisinden ayrilarak kurtulma fikrini verir; ayni ag icinde baskasini kurtarma ve kurtulusa sebep olan sey de yer alir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Insan, binek ve yolculuk baglamlarinda cekirdegi temsil eder; kurtulus anlamini tasimaz.

error_profile.preserves: Hizli hareket ve gitme cekirdegini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanin, binegin ya da yolculuk hareketinin hizla gitmesi, acele etmesi veya one gecmesidir; hayvan nitelemesinde hizli binek anlamina daralir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam hizli gitme, acele etme ve hareketle one gecmedir.
Binek nitelemesinde hizli deve ya da hizli tasit hayvani anlamina ozellesir.
Yolculuk emrinde oyalanmadan surmek ve gecikmemek anlamina baglanir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculukta oyalanmadan hareket etme emirleri ve fiil kullanimlari icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Acele hareket ve gitme anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binek hayvan nitelemesinde dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hizli binek ozellesmesini korur.

error_profile.adds: Tehlikeden cikma sonucunu ekler.
error_profile.collision: B001 dalinin kurtulus anlamiyla karisir.
error_profile.loses: Hiz ve one gecme cekirdegini yitirir.
error_profile.preserves: Uzaklasma cagrisimini kismen koruyabilir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, hareketin hizina ve one gecmeye baglidir; tehlikeden kurtulma sonucu bu dalin cekirdegi degildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan, binek veya yolculuk icin hizli gitme, acele etme ve one gecme anlamini acikca verir. Dal cercevesi bu hareket-hiz alanini dogru temsil eder; kurtulus, gizli konusma ve bedensel temizlik anlamlari bu daldan ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karisik kapsam, genel hizli gitme fiilini, hizli deve nitelemesini ve yolculukta acele etme bicimini ayri tutmayi gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Hiz, kosu, yuruyus, binek ve ayni kok icindeki kurtulus dallari denetlendi; yayina alinanlar okuyucu icin en olasi karisikliklari karsilar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel hizli gitme baglaminda yakindirlar. Bu dalin binek nitelemesi ve one gecme tonu vardir; komsu dal daha yalindan hareketin surati ve kosu-surus siddetidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda one gecme ve hizli binek nitelemesi de bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal kosma ve yuruyus hizinin siddetine daha dogrudan odaklanir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da hizli hareket ve yol alma alanindadir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal her hizli gidisi karsilayabilir; komsu dalda hizli hareketin kesintisiz ve gevsemeden surmesi daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hizli gitmeyi ve bazen one gecmeyi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal kesintisiz, yorulmayan veya ciddiyetle suren hiz tonunu tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da hareketin hizli olmasini paylasir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal hareketin niteligini, yani hizini anlatir. Komsu dal ise hareketin sonucunu, yani kurtulusu anlatir; hizli olmak zorunda degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda belirleyici unsur hizdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda belirleyici unsur tehlikeden ayrilarak kurtulmadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda hareket ve uzaklasma gorulebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali hiz, acele yurumek veya gitmek, one gecmek ve hizli binek nitelemesi etrafinda ortaklastirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Deri, kabuk, dal ve tel gibi nesnelerdeki maddi ayirma islemini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Soyma, kesme ve yerinden ayirma cekirdegini korur.

concept_map.definition: Deri, kabuk, dal, cubuk ya da tel gibi bir seyi bagli oldugu yuzeyden veya kaynaktan kaziyarak, soyarak, keserek ya da cekip ayirarak cikarmadir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, bir nesneyi bagli oldugu yerden ayirip cikarmadir.
Deri ve kabuk baglaminda kazima, yuzme veya soyma anlamina ozellesir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Collocation kapsam, anlami bir kisiyi koku bakimindan sinama ifadesine baglar ve genel yalın kok anlami yapmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Koku alma, nefes kokusu, agiz, ortaya cikarma, gizli konusma ve ayni kok dallari denetlendi; tartismali siniri gosteren adaylar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal, koku almayi belirli kisi ve agiz kokusu sinamasi baglamina daraltir. Komsu dal her tur kokuyu burunla algilamaya daha genel uygulanir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ozellikle bir kisinin agiz kokusunu sinama collocationina baglidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal genel olarak burunla koku alma ve kokuyu algilama eylemini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da koku alma eylemi vardir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal koku niteligini ve kokunun varligini anlatir. Bu dalda belirleyici olan, bir kisiyi agiz kokusu bakimindan deneme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal koku alma sinamasini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal kokunun kendisi, iyi veya kotu koku ve kokuyu algilama alanini genis kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da nefes veya koku algisi bulunabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal koku sinamasini, komsu dal ise gizli konusmayi anlatir. Itiraz edilen delil nedeniyle sinir notu gerekir, ama dallar anlam bakimindan yerine konmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tartismali olarak agiz kokusunu sinama anlamini korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal gizli konusma ve sir paylasimini cekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir delilin yorumunda iki anlam birbiriyle temas eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklarin cogu bir kisinin agiz kokusunu sinama anlamini aktarir; buna karsilik aktarilan delilin aslinda gizli konusma anlamina gelebilecegi yolunda bir itiraz da vardir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni uzatma yonunu kismen korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve acik bicimde gerinme anlamini verir. Dal cercevesi bu sinirli beden durusu anlamini dogru temsil eder; sir, yuksek yer, cikinti veya kurtulus alanlariyla karistirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, gerinme adini dalin yalın anlami olarak verir; belirli bir tamlamaya baglamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Beden uzatma, boyun germe, yere serilme, oturus ve ayni kok dallari denetlendi; dar gerinme sinirini gosteren adaylar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bedensel gerinme olarak dar ve somuttur. Komsu dal genel uzatma alanidir ve bedene sinirli degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ozellikle bedenin gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal nesne, beden, el veya bakis gibi pek cok seyde genel uzatma ve uzanma alanini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da uzatma veya germe hareketi bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal bedenin belli parcasina, ozellikle boyna odaklanir. Bu dal daha genel gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal butun bedenin gerinmesini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle boynun uzunlugu, kaldirilmasi ve uzatilmasidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bedensel uzama veya germe gorulur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aktif gerinmeyi anlatir. Komsu dal yerde yayilma veya serilme durusudur; hareket ve beden iliskisi ayni degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal gerilerek uzama hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal yere serilme, yayilma veya kollarin yere acilmasi gibi duruslari anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal beden durusu ve uzanma sahnesinde temas eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak verisi bu dali gerinme hareketi olarak tekil ve dar bir anlamla verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi ayrilma ile kurtulma, hizli uzaklasma, yuzeyden ayirma, yuksek yer, gizli konusma, bedenden cikan sey ve temizleme, bulut adi, agiz kokusunu sinama ve gerinme gibi birbirinden ayrilmis anlam alanlarina dagilir. Dallar arasinda yer yer ayrilma veya uzaklasma sezgisi gorulse de butun profil acikca cok anlamli ve karisik orgutludur.

text.arabic_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا

baseline.text: Seni nasıl dinlediklerini en iyi biz biliriz; seni dinledikleri ve kendi aralarında gizlice konuştukları sırada zalimler, 'Siz ancak büyülenmiş bir adama uyuyorsunuz' derler.

findings.text: Tekrarlanan dinleme, kabul için değil, özel konuşmada karşı bir açıklama kurup peygamberi etkisiz bir etikete indirgemek için malzeme toplar; işitsel erişim böylece alıcı yönelişten ayrılır.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower establishes the epistemic pole against which the listeners' inference is measured.
Audition that proceeds by supposition despite failing to see supplies the listeners' incomplete inferential mode.
Speech functioning as conjecture turns incomplete reception into an asserted judgment.
Diversion and deception supply the causal label by which uncertainty is displaced onto the man.

changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes an epistemic asymmetry: God knows the listeners' actual process, while they convert partial audition into a conjectural causal diagnosis.
changed_reading.before: God knows that they listen and reports the insult they utter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening claim of superior knowledge governs the doubled listening and the listeners' concluding diagnosis.
baseline_models.mechanism: Complete disclosure to the divine knower is set against audition that operates by conjecture: partial hearing is converted into a confident claim that the man has been diverted or deceived.

activation_trace.role: Perception of sound supplies the pipeline's raw intake rather than its completed understanding.
Secret consultation forms the closed social chamber in which heard material is recoded.
A saying capable of circulation turns private processing into a reputational output.
Putting a thing in the wrong place describes the transfer of the disturbance from the message's claim to the messenger's condition.
Tracing one effect after another supplies the sustained following that the circulated label is designed to interrupt.
Diversion and deception make the accusation itself an instrument for redirecting prospective followers.

changed_reading.after: The ayah reconstructs a social processing line: acoustic intake becomes closed counsel, then a transmissible smear that obstructs continued following.
changed_reading.before: Some hearers privately exchange an insult after listening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three temporal clauses move from listening, to being a secret council, to saying that only an enchanted man is followed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Auditory intake enters a closed consultation, where it is reformulated as a portable public saying. The resulting label misplaces the source of disturbance onto the messenger and diverts others from sustained following.

activation_trace.role: Repeated auditory attention establishes their own continuing orientation toward the messenger.
Tracing an effect step after step makes following also resemble the listeners' own sustained tracking.
Reducing the addressee to an ordinary male supplies the flattening move in the accusation.
The charge of diversion lets hostile tracking masquerade as a warning against being diverted.

changed_reading.after: Their accusation projects their own repeated tracking onto the followers: they remain attached as hostile auditors while redescribing receptive attachment as enchantment.
changed_reading.before: They contrast free judgment with other people's following of a compromised man.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They repeatedly listen toward the messenger while warning others that they are merely following a man.
baseline_models.mechanism: The listeners themselves keep tracking the messenger's speech, then project that tracked relation onto believers as discreditable dependence. Calling the man enchanted lets them deny normative following while continuing adversarial pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies the contact that remains possible despite the surrounding obstructions.
Understanding and compliance supply the completion of hearing that the context shows failing.
Understanding names the missing uptake even when praise is present throughout the surrounding world.
Prevention of access supplies the outer relational barrier between recitation and audience.
A protective covering supplies the inward filter over the organ of understanding.
The ear's receptive acceptance identifies what the adjacent burden prevents, not merely a loss of sound.
Heaviness in the ear supplies the immediate sensory obstruction through which their later listening is qualified.
Physical and affective distancing gives the filtered reception its observable output.

changed_reading.after: They listen through a layered filter: sound reaches the ear, but covered understanding turns reception into aversion and preserves noncompliance.
changed_reading.before: They hear the recitation but refuse its content.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence separates audible contact from understanding and acceptance. Barrier, inward covering, ear-weight, and withdrawal behave as layered filters through which listening occurs, explaining how sound can arrive while compliance is blocked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive external, inward, auditory, and bodily obstructions; I infer that they specify the operative means or manner in the focus construction 'بما يستمعون به'. A live alternative is direct imposed incapacity rather than a self-reinforcing interpretive filter.
structural_cues: 17:44 contrasts pervasive praise with failure to understand it.
17:45-46 orders barrier, heart-covering, ear-weight, and bodily withdrawal immediately before the focus listening scene.

activation_trace.role: Attributing what is not established supplies the verbal material that the next ayah inspects as a comparison.
Diversion and deception provide the compact explanatory image imposed on the messenger.
Directed perception makes the listeners' framing method itself the object of examination.
Depicting and displaying a comparison identifies their label as an active framing operation.
The struck comparison classifies the enchanted-man charge as one item in their analogical repertoire.
Departure from guidance supplies the consequence of accepting their own frame.
An extended traversable path is precisely what their explanatory comparison leaves them unable to reach.

changed_reading.after: It is a failed explanatory analogy: their listening produces a frame that seems to classify the messenger but disables further orientation.
changed_reading.before: The phrase 'enchanted man' is a free-standing insult.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following instruction exposes the enchanted-man label as a struck comparison: an explanatory frame meant to classify the messenger instead produces directional loss and incapacity to reach a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus accusation and the adjacent command to inspect their comparisons; I infer that 'enchanted man' is one of those comparisons and that framing causes the path-loss. The plural may also gather accusations not stated in the focus ayah.
structural_cues: The next ayah asks how they strike comparisons, echoing the focus ayah's concern with how they listen.
The explicit consequence chain is comparison, straying, then inability to find a path.

activation_trace.role: Unsupported attribution supplies the defensive diagnosis assigned to the messenger.
Diversion and deception make the speaker's condition, rather than the claim's possibility, the proposed cause.
Fragmentation and debris supply the terminal material state from which the objectors cannot imagine return.
Stirring what is still out of rest supplies the denied transition from inert remains to renewed life.
Measurement and estimation supply the bounded model by which they test the possibility of a new creation.
Stone supplies a harder limiting case than bones and fragments.
Iron's resistant hardness intensifies the imagined material barrier to recreation.
Origination supplies the answering capacity that exceeds their inherited material measure.

changed_reading.after: It can function as an ontology-defense: a claim that exceeds familiar material measurement is neutralized by locating the abnormality in its human bearer.
changed_reading.before: The enchanted-man charge is a generic attack on credibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation is followed by an objection built from fragmentation, reanimation, renewed creation, and even harder imagined matter. Calling the messenger enchanted relocates the anomaly from a claim that breaks their material measure to a defect in the claimant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the accusation followed by a tightly developed material objection; I infer that the label protects the objectors' ontology by pathologizing its challenger. The alternative is that the resurrection exchange begins a separate objection with no specific causal tie to the accusation.
structural_cues: 17:49 opens with another act of saying and immediately specifies the resurrection objection.
17:50-51 escalate from remains to stone and iron, then answer by invoking first origination.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance define hearing's completed receptive form.
Unsupported attribution supplies the substitute output where receptive response should have occurred.
A vocal call that inclines its addressee supplies the initiating signal.
Returning speech and answering supply the fitting completion of a received call.

changed_reading.after: Listening is tested by its output: true reception answers the call, whereas the focus listeners replace response with a socially manufactured counter-speech.
changed_reading.before: Listening is established by auditory attendance alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later call reaches its proper completion in response. That sound-to-response chain exposes the focus sequence as an anti-response in which hearing terminates instead in private counsel and slander.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one reception chain ending in response and another ending in accusation; I infer a contrast between completed hearing and hostile processing. The eschatological call may remain a distinct scene rather than a direct gloss on present listening.
structural_cues: 17:52 places calling and responding in immediate verbal succession.
The focus ayah instead sequences three temporal stages from listening through counsel to hostile speech.

activation_trace.role: Secret consultation supplies the closed relay in which divisive speech is coordinated.
Circulating talk allows the council's compact phrase to shape relations beyond the private exchange.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the normative speech output that would interrupt the hostile relay.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies the social effect of weaponized saying.
A thrust made with a word gives the enchanted-man label its local action within that social corruption.
The connection between parties is the relation that hostile speech damages and better speech preserves.

changed_reading.after: The council is a speech relay: it converts listening into a verbal thrust that recruits division, while the command to say what is best offers the circuit-breaker.
changed_reading.before: The council merely expresses a shared private judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to produce better speech interrupts a rival circuit in which words provoke division between people. The focus secret council is the incubator of that rival circuit, and the enchanted-man phrase is its verbal thrust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed speech outputs and names word-driven interhuman incitement; I infer that the focus counsel is a production point in that circuit. The alternative is a general ethical instruction not specifically diagnosing this council.
structural_cues: 17:53 opens with a command about what servants should say, lexically answering the wrongdoers' saying in the focus ayah.
The same ayah locates verbal provocation between human parties rather than only inside an individual hearer.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower places the concealed listening process within divine knowledge.
The repeated superior-knowledge formula extends that disclosure from their listening method to the persons themselves.
Messenger and message define the entrusted communicative office without assigning control of reception.
The sufficient guardian role is explicitly negated for the messenger, delimiting his responsibility for the hostile audience.
A second repetition broadens the same knowing jurisdiction across all who occupy the heavens and earth.

changed_reading.after: It also relieves the messenger of covert audience-management: their mode of reception is fully known by God, while his office remains transmission rather than guardianship.
changed_reading.before: The opening knowledge claim chiefly threatens the concealed listeners with exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated superior-knowledge formulas assign knowledge of audiences to God, while the messenger's guardianship over them is explicitly denied. The focus opening therefore reassures and allocates jurisdiction: hostile interior reception is known without becoming the messenger's burden to police.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated knowledge formulas and a negated guardian role; I infer that the focus declaration also functions as reassurance and jurisdiction allocation. It can still function simply as an omniscience claim without this pastoral force.
structural_cues: The construction of superior knowledge with a following bi-phrase recurs in 17:47, 17:54, and 17:55.
17:54 couples that recurrence with the explicit denial that the messenger was sent as guardian over them.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance establish the receptive gain that mere repeated listening fails to deliver.
Increase supplies the paradoxical gain term whose actual output is greater distance.
Drawing away supplies the negative output generated by further exposure to the recitation.
A manifest sign supplies evidence in another sensory register whose visibility still does not force reception.
Eye-sight supplies direct visual availability as a countercase to the assumption that clearer access yields belief.
Repeated increase confirms that the response grows with exposure even when it grows in the wrong direction.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the intensified negative response to warning.
The second mapped target independently preserves the same limit-crossing image rather than collapsing the split root.

changed_reading.after: Exposure has negative gain: the listeners actively convert added contact into stronger distance, culminating locally in a more portable counter-description of the messenger.
changed_reading.before: Repeated listening should at least increase informational access, even if the audience rejects it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the packet, increased recitational variation, a visible sign, and a displayed vision do not guarantee insight; exposure can increase aversion or transgression. The focus listening is one instance of this reverse-gain process, where more contact produces a stronger counter-frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exposure-to-adverse-output sequences in auditory, visible, and visionary settings; I infer a shared reverse-gain mechanism and place the focus counsel inside it. The scenes may instead be independent examples with no single reception law.
structural_cues: 17:41 and 17:60 repeat the formula in which an input increases only an adverse response.
17:59 inserts a visible sign between those recitational and visionary failures, making sensory modality insufficient across hearing and sight.

remaining_uncertainties: The focus bi-construction can still foreground what they hear, the means by which they hear, their motive, or their manner in different proportions.
The resurrection exchange may reveal the pressure behind the accusation, or it may begin a distinct objection without that causal link.
The fetter and raised-ground activations should remain imagistic outliers rather than lexical renderings.
strongest_changes: Listening became a layered reception filter rather than a neutral acoustic act.
The enchanted-man label became both a failed analogy and a possible defense of a bounded material ontology.
Secret counsel became a speech circuit that converts heard material into circulating incitement.
The repeated knowledge formulas recast the opening as reassurance that covert reception belongs to divine knowledge, not messenger guardianship.
Call-response and reverse-gain sequences made the listeners' hostile output, rather than mere contact, the test of their hearing.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly exposes processing method: auditory, visual, and visionary contact can be filtered into distance, while the focus ayah uniquely slows that conversion into listening, closed counsel, and a portable reputational frame.

activation_trace.role: The paired hearing-points of a fetter cast doubled listening as a coupling that can constrain rather than open the listeners.
Secret consultation supplies the collective linkage through which the auditory constraint becomes social.
Heaviness located in the ear keeps the constraint image connected to the immediate reception sequence.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, repeated listening can bind the hearers into a closed interpretive coupling whose weight restricts any response outside the council.
changed_reading.before: Listening is an available opening that the group fails to use.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fetter is an object-sense within the hearing inventory, not the ordinary lexical sense of the repeated verb. It remains anchored by the doubled hearing root, the paired social process, and the adjacent ear-weight; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material analogy, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hearing verb occurs twice before the listeners become a single secret council.

activation_trace.role: Escape by separation makes the council an attempted withdrawal from the address that has reached them.
Raised ground safe from inundation supplies a spatial image for the group's protected interpretive enclave.
A screening barrier supports the enclave's separation from direct encounter with the recitation.
Covering supplies the protected surface by which the council remains socially insulated.

changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial activation, the council becomes constructed high ground: the hearers separate into an enclave meant to stay untouched, then speak from that protected position.
changed_reading.before: Secret counsel is simply a low-voiced exchange hidden from others.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the topographic and escape branches behind the ordinary secret-counsel noun. It remains anchored in that focus root and in the preceding barrier sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial model of social withdrawal, not substitute it for the noun's direct sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The listeners become secret counsel after auditory contact and before issuing their accusation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Listening is repurposed as material for a private counter-frame.** `س م ع:B001/B003/B013` spans hearing, compliance, and suspicious audition; `ن ج و:B004/B005` is separated high ground and private counsel; `ت ب ع:B001/B003` follows and tracks; `س ح ر:B002` diverts by deception. Repeated listening moves into secluded discussion and a label that explains away following. I infer they hear in order to build interpretive distance, not receive. The ayah distinguishes acoustic access from receptive orientation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:101 repeats “bewitched” after nine clear signs. The recurrence showed private counter-framing here to be a durable political defense against cumulative evidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Private counsel preloads the act of listening.** Lexical evidence: `ن ج و B005` (private counsel) in `نَجْوَىٰٓ`, and `س ح ر B002` (magic as diversion and deception) in `مَّسْحُورًا`. Structural cue: `يَسْتَمِعُونَ` is repeated around `بِمَا`, then private counsel yields the public interpretive label; 17:45–46 supplies the veil and blocked organs, while 17:48 calls their representations path-destroying. Assigned role: counsel builds a shared filter, and the magic label diverts the heard message into an account of a defective messenger. Abductive move: the packet gives listening, counsel, and label in sequence; I infer that the social frame governs what they are listening “with.” Reading change: their listening is active coalition-based recoding, not neutral exposure followed by an independent judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:48–49 showed the filter's downstream output: “bewitched” becomes a family of path-destroying representations, including the claim that fragmented bodies cannot return.

words.gloss_range: emphatic independent first-person plural pronoun opening the divine witness frame
words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) makes the divine speaker the first visible element. The ayah does not begin as a neutral report about opponents; it opens with direct divine self-reference, continuing the first-person agency from (17:46) and turning the hidden scene of listening, counsel, and accusation into something already witnessed.

topics.headline: fronted pronoun opens divine witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine agency is foregrounded before any hostile action is described.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is overt and initial in a nominal sentence, so it bears emphasis rather than merely supplying recoverable agreement.

topics.headline: first-person assertion continues the prior boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that (17:47) continues (17:46) by moving from their aversion into divine exposure of the same group.
topics.reason: The prior ayah supplies the hostile third-person group, while the new first-person pronoun presents divine knowledge as the answer to that concealed continuity.

words.gloss_range: elative predicate of superior knowing, locally specified by the following prepositional complement
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:aʿlamu}}) is not a bare statement that God knows; its elative form ranks divine knowledge over the opponents own reading of events. The following prepositional complement defines the domain as their listening, so the opening certainty covers motive, means, and content before the whispered accusation appears. In Surah 17 this know-best formula also resonates with (17:25), (17:54), (17:55), and the accountability of hearing in (17:36).
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, cognizance, and certainty; local form ranks divine knowledge over rival conjecture and hostile speech

topics.headline: elative knowledge is locally scoped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that superior knowledge is aimed at the exact field of their listening, not left as a general attribute.
topics.reason: The elative predicate is completed by the governed complement, which identifies the domain of knowledge.

topics.headline: knowledge confronts conjectural accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certain divine knowledge frames the whole hostile sequence of listening, saying, and wrongdoing before the quote speaks.
topics.reason: The root semantics and co-occurrence rows make knowledge the counterweight to the later discrediting claim.

topics.headline: Surah 17 know-best thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this instance joins Surah 17 repeated know-best formula and the earlier accountability of hearing in (17:36).
topics.reason: The concrete rows tie this word to same-surah uses in (17:25), (17:54), and (17:55), and to the hearing/accountability frame in (17:36).

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the domain, means, or cause of what is known
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the knowledge claim relational: God knows with respect to what they listen by, through, or because of. The particle keeps instrument and motive together, and it comes before the temporal scenes so the later listening and private counsel unfold as evidence of a domain already under divine knowledge.

topics.headline: preposition opens means and motive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah probes not only that they listen, but what operates through or behind that listening.
topics.reason: The governed prepositional frame can carry domain, instrument, and cause, and the later resumptive pronoun preserves that breadth.

topics.headline: domain precedes temporal unpacking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah states the known domain before it opens the staged scenes.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement appears before the first temporal particle, so it frames the following scene sequence.

words.gloss_range: governed pronoun or nominalizer leaving the listened-to element or listening manner open
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is governed by the preceding preposition, so the following listening clause belongs inside the knowledge frame. Its surface can be read as what they listen with or as the act and manner of their listening, leaving the object deliberately unexposed until the ayah shows the listening, the private counsel, and the quote.

topics.headline: governed element binds the listening clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the listening clause is grammatically inside the domain of divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun, making the clause its complement rather than an independent question.

topics.headline: relative and nominalizing readings remain local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording can cover content, faculty, motive, or manner while the local syntax keeps all of that inside the listening frame.
topics.reason: The surface permits relative and nominalizing parses; local grammar narrows both to the governed complement of divine knowledge.

words.gloss_range: first Form X listening verb, effortful and governed by a means/cause complement
words.prose: The first {{ar:يَسْتَمِعُونَ}} ({{tr:yastamiʿūna}}) presents listening as effortful and agenda-bearing. Because this occurrence is completed by a bound prepositional complement, the ayah looks inside the act, toward its means or motive, before the second occurrence turns toward the Prophet. The root also recalls accountable hearing in (17:36), and the repeated verb makes listening the first stage in a movement from attention to whispering to accusation. The parallel in (47:16) sharpens the danger: hostile listeners may hear without absorbing what was said.
words.root_gloss_range: hearing and listening as a moral faculty; local Form X selects deliberate attending or overhearing rather than passive sound reception

topics.headline: first listening takes means or motive complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first listening clause asks what they listen by or for before naming the outward target.
topics.reason: The verb is locally completed by the bound prepositional complement rather than by a directional target.

topics.headline: Form X makes hearing deliberate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their hearing is a chosen use of a moral faculty, not accidental reception.
topics.reason: Form X and the hearing-root evidence support deliberate attending or overhearing, and (17:36) makes the faculty accountable.

topics.headline: repeated verb starts the covert sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same listening form helps move the ayah from inner motive to outward target and then into private accusation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the repeated verb, the governor shift, and the sound-thread from listening into counsel and following.

topics.headline: parallel shows hostile listening without uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same pattern of accountable hearing can become listening without true reception, as in (47:16) and in the echo with (17:36).
topics.reason: The concrete references connect this word to (47:16) and to the accountable hearing frame of (17:36).

words.gloss_range: bound preposition plus pronoun resuming the ambiguous known object, means, or motive
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:bihī}}) keeps the earlier openness compactly alive. The suffix points back into the earlier open complement, while the attached preposition lets the referent function as means, cause, or content. The thing being listened by or because of is therefore present in grammar but still concealed in wording, matching the hidden scene the ayah exposes.

topics.headline: suffix resumes the open complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun preserves, rather than resolves, what lies behind their listening.
topics.reason: The pronoun resumes the earlier governed element inside a relative-style frame.

topics.headline: preposition and suffix compress hidden relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the concealed means or motive is grammatically bound into one small word.
topics.reason: The attached preposition governs the suffix, allowing cause and instrument to remain live without naming an independent noun.

words.gloss_range: first temporal marker opening the observed listening scene
words.prose: The first {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) turns the knowledge claim into an observed time. It begins the ayah descending through three exposed layers: listening, private counsel, and the quoted accusation. This first layer keeps the opponents from remaining a general type; they are shown at a concrete moment of listening.

topics.headline: first temporal marker concretizes the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is anchored in a specific exposed occasion.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb introduces the first circumstantial clause after the knowledge statement.

topics.headline: first shell of the threefold descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving layer by layer from outward listening to inner accusation.
topics.reason: The repeated temporal markers organize listening, private counsel, and quoted speech as progressive exposure.

words.gloss_range: second Form X listening verb, now directed toward the Prophet by its complement
words.prose: The second {{ar:يَسْتَمِعُونَ}} ({{tr:yastamiʿūna}}) repeats the same deliberate listening form, but now the complement points outward. The contrast with the first occurrence is the payoff: the ayah first exposes what is operating through their listening, then shows whom they aim that listening toward. After the flight-away image of (17:46), this directed listening creates an ironic posture of aversion and approach at once.
words.root_gloss_range: hearing and deliberate listening; local repetition keeps effortful listening while the complement changes from means/motive to target

topics.headline: same verb with a new governor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated listening is not redundant because the second occurrence marks the target.
topics.reason: The verb repeats Form X but takes a directional complement rather than the earlier bound means/cause complement.

topics.headline: governor shift maps motive and target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah mapping one act through two axes: hidden means or motive and visible target.
topics.reason: The local repetition with changed preposition creates a contrastive reprise.

topics.headline: flight away becomes listening toward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group shown turning away in (17:46) is also shown deliberately listening toward the Prophet.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the aversion-to-approach contrast with the previous ayah.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition plus second-person suffix identifying the Prophet as target
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) fixes the outward vector of the listening: it is toward the addressed Prophet. The phrase shifts from hidden means or motive to a visible target, and it makes the irony sharper after (17:46): those turning away are still trying to gain auditory access to him.

topics.headline: second-person suffix fixes the target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their listening is aimed at the Prophet specifically, not at ambient sound.
topics.reason: The directional preposition governs the second-person suffix as the target of the listening verb.

topics.headline: movement from hidden medium to open target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structure moving from internal mechanics to the person addressed.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly contrast the earlier bound complement with this directional target.

topics.headline: directed approach after exterior retreat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contradiction between their retreat in (17:46) and their directed listening here.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence connects the direction toward the Prophet with the prior image of turning away.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding a second temporal scene while preserving distinction
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second scene connected to the first without collapsing them. Public listening and private counsel become coordinated stages in one exposed process: they listen, and then the ayah shows them in the private huddle that produces the accusation.

topics.headline: conjunction joins but distinguishes stages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that listening and private counsel are linked stages rather than one blurred action.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second temporal clause with the first.

topics.headline: connection marks narrative progression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah advancing from public exposure to the concealed huddle.
topics.reason: The sequence rows identify the conjunction as a cumulative transition into private counsel.

words.gloss_range: second temporal marker introducing the nominal private-counsel state
words.prose: The second {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) opens a new layer, but with a different clause type: not an action verb, but a nominal identification of the group with private counsel. As the middle hinge of the threefold sequence, it prevents the ayah from jumping straight from listening to accusation; it exposes the deliberative chamber between them. The repeated short temporal markers give the sequence a clipped cadence, resetting the scene one layer deeper each time.

topics.headline: second temporal marker opens the huddle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that private counsel is time-locked as a distinct exposed state after listening.
topics.reason: The second temporal adverb introduces a coordinated nominal clause rather than another listening verb.

topics.headline: middle hinge between hearing and quote
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a staged narrowing: each repeated temporal marker resets the scene deeper inside the opponents process.
topics.reason: The repeated markers create a clipped three-step architecture, with this one mediating between public listening and quoted speech.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person plural pronoun making the whispering group explicit
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the whisperers visible as a group before the abstract predicate arrives. The wording does not merely say that they whisper; it makes them the subject of a nominal identification with private counsel. The carried group from (17:46) is re-identified at the moment their concealed deliberation is exposed.

topics.headline: independent pronoun fixes the whisperers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the private counsel belongs to this same visible group, not to an unnamed generic opposition.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is retained as a standalone subject before the predicate.

topics.headline: pronoun plus abstract predicate equates group with act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is portrayed as constituted by covert consultation at this moment.
topics.reason: The nominal sentence identifies the persons with the abstract predicate rather than using a simple finite verb.

words.gloss_range: abstract verbal noun used as predicate, selecting secret counsel as the local sense
words.prose: {{ar:نَجْوَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:najwā}}) is the abstract predicate that turns the plural group into a state of private counsel. The local sense is secrecy, not rescue, but the root background makes the scene ironic: the counsel meant to shelter or remove them from exposure is exactly what divine knowledge brings into quotation. The same configuration of secret counsel, wrongdoers, and a magical or humanizing accusation appears in (21:3).
words.root_gloss_range: secrecy, private discourse, removal, elevation, and rescue; local predicate selects concealed counsel while preserving shelter/removal irony

topics.headline: abstract predicate identifies the group with counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording makes private counsel a defining state of the group, not a passing side action.
topics.reason: The abstract verbal noun functions as predicate of the plural pronoun and compresses the group into one covert communicative state.

topics.headline: secret counsel selected over rescue range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a word-field with shelter, rescue, or removal pressure locally names secrecy that cannot protect them from exposure.
topics.reason: The root range is broader than the local sense; the predicate slot selects secret counsel while allowing shelter/removal imagery as a narrowed pressure.

topics.headline: secret counsel generates hostile speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that concealed deliberation is the chamber where the wrongdoers discrediting speech is formed, with a concrete parallel in (21:3).
topics.reason: The rows connect local private counsel to wrongdoing and saying fields, the boundary movement from retreat to deliberation, and the explicit parallel in (21:3).

words.gloss_range: third temporal marker that also explains the content of the private counsel
words.prose: The third {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) is the innermost hinge. It still places the saying in time, but it also explains what the private counsel consisted of. After listening and huddling, this particle opens the actual accusation, so the ayah reaches the words themselves.

topics.headline: third marker explains the counsel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final temporal marker does more than date the event; it identifies the content of the huddle.
topics.reason: The third temporal clause is appositional or explanatory to the private-counsel state while still functioning temporally.

topics.headline: innermost layer reaches accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the architecture reaching its core: listening, huddle, then quoted speech.
topics.reason: The row family identifies this marker as the final shell in the three-stage exposure.

words.gloss_range: imperfect Form I speech verb opening the direct quotation
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُ}} ({{tr:yaqūlu}}) turns private counsel into articulate speech. Its imperfect aspect keeps the saying active inside the exposed scene, while the normal preposed singular verb delays the named plural subject until the speech-act has begun. The quote is not summarized; it is brought out as direct language, and the same rejection formula recurs in (25:8).
words.root_gloss_range: articulate speech and saying; local form exposes private counsel as quotable words without adding causative force

topics.headline: imperfect verb makes the saying unfold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the accusation as an active scene of speech, not only a past report.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form I speech verb opens the utterance plainly and aspectually within the exposed moment.

topics.headline: preposed singular verb delays speaker naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech-act arriving before the speakers moral label is named.
topics.reason: The singular preposed verb is licensed by Arabic VSO agreement and creates a sequence where saying precedes explicit subject identification.

topics.headline: counsel becomes quotable assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine exposure does not paraphrase their private counsel; it quotes its formed content.
topics.reason: The root semantics and discourse evidence mark the move from concealed deliberation into direct speech.

topics.headline: same quoted rejection formula recurs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this saying belongs to a recurring rejection formula also quoted in (25:8).
topics.reason: The concrete rows give the recurrence in (25:8).

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural active participle naming the speakers as wrongdoers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimūna}}) names the speakers after the verb of saying has begun, so the moral label lands on the source of the quote. The active participle presents them as an identifiable class of wrongdoers, and the root image of displacement fits the act itself: they misplace reality by reducing the Prophet to the final slur. The label also confirms the barrier state exposed in (17:46). The same constellation appears in (25:8), and Surah 17 echoes the dismissal pattern again in (17:101).
words.root_gloss_range: wrongdoing, displacement from proper place, and darkening; local participle characterizes the speakers and their accusation as displacing truth

topics.headline: delayed subject labels the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are morally identified precisely as their accusation is exposed.
topics.reason: The nominative subject follows the speech verb and carries definite moral labeling before the direct quote proceeds.

topics.headline: root image makes the accusation displacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their speech performs the very displacement and darkening named by the label.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports wrongdoing as misplacement and darkening, which locally applies to the false accusation.

topics.headline: definite participle classifies the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording presents wrongdoing as an agentive characterization, not a one-time anonymous act.
topics.reason: The active participle and definiteness classify the speakers as a known group.

topics.headline: wrongdoer label recurs in rejection formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this label belongs to a wider pattern: (25:8) repeats the formula, while (17:46) and (17:101) frame obstruction and prophetic dismissal within the same surah.
topics.reason: The concrete references connect the label to (25:8), the boundary with (17:46), and the later charge in (17:101).

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the restriction frame completed by the later exception particle
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) is negative here, not conditional. It opens the restriction that will be completed by the later exception particle, so the quote is built as exclusion from the start: no account of followership is allowed except the discrediting category that closes the ayah. The grammar itself performs the opponents narrowing, and (17:99) shows the same wrongdoer/rejection pressure in another restricted refusal.

topics.headline: negative particle opens restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote is not hypothetical; it is a totalizing negation.
topics.reason: The evidence tags the particle as negative and links it with the later exception particle.

topics.headline: negation and exception confine the accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted accusation is syntactically engineered to exclude every honorable alternative.
topics.reason: The particle starts a scope that runs through the final insult phrase and creates restriction by negation plus exception.

topics.headline: restriction language aligns with later rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wrongdoers speech here shares a rejection pattern with (17:99).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row connects the present wrongdoer speech to (17:99).

words.gloss_range: Form VIII second-person plural imperfect inside the restriction frame
words.prose: {{ar:تَتَّبِعُونَ}} ({{tr:tattabiʿūna}}) is the action placed under the restriction: the opponents claim the addressed group does nothing but follow the final insult phrase. The second-person plural shifts the quote from third-person exposure to direct address, while Form VIII makes the alleged following deliberate adherence. The doubled consonantal pressure suits that charge, making the following sound like pressing into adherence. The root image of trailing footsteps is sharpened because the object is a man, and the whole formula recurs in (25:8).
words.root_gloss_range: following, pursuing, and moving after; local Form VIII makes the accused followership deliberate adherence to a human object

topics.headline: verb is the action confined by restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opponents restrict the very act of following, not merely the description of the Prophet.
topics.reason: The verb sits between the negative and exception particles inside the quoted restriction.

topics.headline: quote shifts into second-person plural
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech turning from narrated opponents to an addressed audience inside their accusation.
topics.reason: The imperfect second-person plural form marks ongoing alleged following by the addressees in the quote.

topics.headline: Form VIII and root image make adherence deliberate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation imagines followers actively choosing to trail a human path.
topics.reason: Form VIII supports deliberate adherence, and the root-image rows make the human object important for the footstep-following pressure.

topics.headline: follow-verb belongs to repeated formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exact followership accusation recurs in (25:8).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give the verbatim recurrence in (25:8).

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the restrictive negation and leaving the insult as sole category
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restriction opened by the earlier negative particle. Its force is exclusion, not description: it removes other possible accounts of following and leaves only the reductive noun-adjective phrase. This small particle therefore closes the ayah around a polemical confinement, while answering the earlier open domain of what they listen by or because of.

topics.headline: exception closes the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the insult phrase becoming the only permitted category inside the opponents grammar.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the local negation-plus-exception construction.

topics.headline: opening inquiry and closing restriction bookend the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that small particles govern both the hidden motive at the opening and the narrowed accusation at the close.
topics.reason: The row explicitly connects the opening prepositional frame with the closing restriction frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative singular human noun, object of following inside the exception
words.prose: {{ar:رَجُلًۭا}} ({{tr:rajulan}}) supplies the object left by the restriction: the followers are said to follow a man. Its accusative role makes the object human rather than doctrinal, and its singular indefiniteness makes the reduction generic, as if the Prophet were just some man. The local root pressure is narrowed: the selected sense is human male, but beside the follow-verb the foot or walking background makes the accusation sound like trailing an ordinary embodied path. Human-messenger objection recurs in (10:2), (21:7), and within Surah 17 at (17:94).
words.root_gloss_range: adult man with related foot/walking imagery; local object role selects human reduction while nearby following keeps walking-after pressure

topics.headline: accusative object makes the followed entity human
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation personalizes followership around a human object rather than an idea or path.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative object of the follow-verb inside the exception frame.

topics.headline: case and indefiniteness bind noun to adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human noun and discrediting adjective land as one bound insult phrase.
topics.reason: Shared accusative indefiniteness and cadence bind the noun to its adjective.

topics.headline: human sense selected, footstep image colors context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local sense is a man, while the nearby follow-verb lets the root background evoke walking after a human path.
topics.reason: The local object role selects the human noun; the foot/walking field remains only as contextual pressure beside the follow-verb.

topics.headline: indefinite singular strips status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dismissive compression of a prophetic figure into one indefinite singular human category.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite accusative with tanwin supports generic reduction.

topics.headline: humanity as objection recurs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the humanity objection belongs to a wider pattern in (10:2), (21:7), and is intensified here by the adjective.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels in (10:2) and (21:7), with the same axis later visible in (17:94).

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative passive participle adjective completing the insult phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مَّسْحُورًا}} ({{tr:masḥūran}}) completes the insult as an accusative indefinite adjective bound to the preceding human noun. Its passive participle form is crucial: the Prophet is cast as acted upon, not as an agent of magic. The root field makes altered perception the charge, while dawn-liminal and mortal-bodied pressures remain secondary because the word modifies the human noun. Since (17:46) has just located obstruction on the opponents hearts and ears, the final word exposes projection. Its recurrence with the same phrase in (25:8), the human-messenger objection in (17:94), the same-surah charge in (17:101), and the next command to look in (17:48) make the closing word a convergence point rather than a loose adjective. The recitational boundary affects connection into (17:48), not lexical sense, and the long accusative close leads into that command to look.
words.root_gloss_range: magic, altered perception, dawn-liminality, and mortality-related secondary senses; local passive participle selects bewitched or perception-altered accusation while human context keeps mortality pressure near

topics.headline: agreement completes compact insult phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is grammatically fused to the human noun as one dismissive phrase.
topics.reason: The passive participle adjective agrees with the noun in accusative case and indefiniteness.

topics.headline: passive participle removes agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation casts the Prophet as someone acted upon rather than as one who acts by magic.
topics.reason: The passive participle pattern and rarity evidence mark affectedness, distinguishing this form from agentive magic-field labels.

topics.headline: bewitched sense dominates with perception and mortality pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local accusation is bewitched or perception-altered, while dawn-liminal and mortal-bodied senses remain secondary pressures beside the human noun.
topics.reason: The local adjective in an insult phrase selects the magic/perception accusation; other root-field senses are kept only as narrowed semantic pressure.

topics.headline: altered perception is projected onto the Prophet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the charge of distorted perception lands on the Prophet after (17:46) has described the opponents own perceptual obstruction.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence and root image converge: the previous ayah locates obstruction on the opponents, while their quote projects alteration onto the Prophet.

topics.headline: closing insult belongs to repeated prophetic dismissal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final accusation is formulaic across (25:8), tied to Surah 17 human-messenger objection in (17:94), and repeated against Moses in (17:101).
topics.reason: The rows give exact recurrence in (25:8), intra-surah links to (17:94) and (17:101), and a trans-prophetic dismissal pattern.

topics.headline: boundary sound leads into command to look
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lexical accusation remains fixed while the recitational boundary and long accusative close lead into the command to look in (17:48).
topics.reason: The qiraat rows affect connection into the next ayah, not lexical meaning, so the payoff is narrowed to formal boundary pressure and the forward bridge to (17:48).
